name: fminbnd
expr: x0 = fminbnd(@(x) (x-3)^2, 0, 10); r1 = double(x0); [x, fval, ef] = fminbnd(@(x) (x-3)^2 + 1, 0, 10);
comment: Sig: x = fminbnd(fn, lo, hi[, tol]); [x, fval, exitflag] = fminbnd(...). Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b on probed quadratic (x=3, fval=1). fval = fn(x) at the minimizer; exitflag = 1 (converged).
